title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-green-core: carry parked/agent/green-core onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/green-core` at 2d85ede20c holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: README.md, agents/AGENTS.md, dashboard/test/dashboard.test.mjs, doctrine/claims.json, foundation/tenantsync.py, seed/agents/AGENTS.md)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/green-core
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/green-core

**Evidence:** Obsolete: the branch is a one-time regeneration of drifted data, SPDX headers and fixtures (744 insertions, 678 deletions) against an old main; REGEN-GENERATED-1 regenerates that data on every merge, so applying it would regress newer content.
